# Introduction

A recurring question in any data platform is deceptively simple: **"What data do we actually have?"**

For EcoCommons, the datasets that power species distribution models and spatial analyses live behind the **data-ingester API**. There is a public data explorer, and there are import tools — but neither answers the question in one shot. To audit the platform properly we needed a single, authoritative list of every dataset record in production, with enough metadata to slice it by category, time domain, and collection.

# What is actually in production?

### By category

The catalogue is overwhelmingly **climate** data.

| Category | Records |
|:---|---:|
| Climate | 55,485 |
| Vegetation | 2,099 |
| Biodiversity | 407 |
| Marine | 204 |
| Topography | 129 |
| Human Activity | 18 |
| Freshwater | 17 |
| Soil | 11 |
| Boundary Data | 9 |
| *(uncategorised / unknown)* | 45 |

### By time domain

| Time domain | Records |
|:---|---:|
| Future | 54,614 |
| Current | 3,810 |

### By collection (top of ~54)

| Collection | Records |
|:---|---:|
| **WorldClim-v2.1** | **52,308** |
| Australia current and future climate data | 2,594 |
| MODIS Vegetation Fraction Cover: monthly layers | 1,785 |
| eBird Range Maps (Status & Trends, 2023) | 401 |
| Queensland Government Climate Datasets | 239 |
| Australia fPAR | 219 |
| Bio-Oracle v3.0 — Marine Environmental Layers | 117 |
| Australian Water Availability Project | 114 |
